title.narrative: Multi Donor Trust Fund for Transitional Demobilization and Reintegration Program (TDRP) in the Great Lakes Region

description.narrative:
"As successor to the Multi-country Demobilization and Reintegration Program (MDRP), the development objective of the Transitional Demobilization and Reintegration Program (TDRP) will be consistent with the original goal of the MDRP set out in 2002, that is, to enhance the prospects for stabilization and recovery in the Great Lakes Region (GLR) by supporting Demobilization and Reintegration (D&R) and related activities. The proposed program has three specific objectives:
a. Facilitate the implementation and improve the quality of D&R programs in the GLR through the provision of financial and technical support and advisory services to D&R operations;
b. Facilitate new D&R programming by providing emergency response financing and advisory and technical support for potential or emerging caseloads of ex-combatants that are not being addressed by country programs or do not have access to other funding sources; and
c. Facilitate a platform for dialogue, information exchange and learning on D&R in the sub-region with a view to improving the quality of on-going D&R efforts, reducing duplication of efforts across the GLR, strengthening coordination on D&R policy and programming, and generating policy advice for future programs."
